newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Opposition wants S.African health minister fired.
newsitem.headline: Opposition wants S.African health minister fired.

text.p: South Africa's opposition National Party called on Wednesday for Health Minister Nkosazana Zuma to be fired after her department was accused of failing to account for 58 million rand ($13 million) in spending.

Auditor-general Henri Kleuver told parliament the figure for the 1995/96 financial year included 14 million rand ($3.17 million) which Zuma spent on a Broadway-style play, Sarafina II, which was intended to increase awareness of AIDS.
Kleuver said the health department was the worst culprit among nine government departments which had totalled unauthorised spending of 151.6 million rand ($34.3 million).
"The National Party demands that President Nelson Mandela immediately dismiss the minister of health...for reasons substantiated by the auditor-general," the party said in a statement.
"The African National Congress leadership can no longer escape taking overall responsibility for the fiasco that is being enacted in the department of health," it said. ($=4.42 rand)
